holds.name: @xyflow/react
holds.reason: pnpm install of 13.0.0-next.0 fails: 'High-risk trust downgrade for "@xyflow/react@13.0.0-next.0" (possible package takeover)' (trustPolicy no-downgrade). 13.0.0-next.0 and its dependency @xyflow/system 1.0.0-next.4 were published manually by npm user webk1d without provenance or trusted publisher, while 12.12.0 carries trusted-publisher SLSA provenance. No upstream tag, changelog or migration guide for v13 exists. Recheck every sweep and move when a v13 build ships with provenance.

holds.name: tailwindcss
holds.reason: Every build after 8cc0551 (insiders 654f89f, 410a465, cd5831f, 2626ae6 = 4.3.4) ships a @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi whose tailwindcss-oxide.wasi.cjs blocks the main thread forever on require (Node 28.0.0-nightly2026110370074c6f98; timeout exit 124 after 15 s, no event-loop ticks), so CI's NAPI_RS_FORCE_WASI=true pnpm check:compiler hangs at `import "@tailwindcss/vite"`. 8cc0551 and 4.3.3 load in about 30 ms with the same bundled @napi-rs/wasm-runtime 1.2.2 and @emnapi 1.11.3. The first bad build follows tailwindcss commit 654f89f (#20651), which only moved the release workflows off the macos-14 runner, so the published WASI artifact changed, not the source. Checked 2026-11-04. Recheck every sweep: move when the newest oxide-wasm32-wasi loads.

holds.name: @tailwindcss/vite
holds.reason: Moves in lockstep with tailwindcss (same insiders build); held with it because its @tailwindcss/oxide WASI binding hangs on load in every build after 8cc0551 (see the tailwindcss hold).
